title: Sidebar filter inputs share LemonInput style; Chat uses inputComponent=Combobox.Input
answers: How to make the chat filter field look like the Apps/Files filter?
How do I use a custom input element inside LemonInput?
What placeholder/icon do sidebar filter fields use?
body:
Apps, Files and Chat sidebar filters are all `LemonInput type="search" size="small"` with `min-h-[30px]`, an `IconSearch` prefix wrapped in `flex items-center justify-center size-4 ml-[2px] mr-px`, and placeholders 'Filter apps' / 'Filter files' / 'Filter chats'. Match these when adding a new sidebar filter.
NavTabChat.tsx needs Base UI `Combobox.Input` for keyboard selection, so LemonInput gained an `inputComponent` prop (LemonInput.tsx) that replaces the native `input` (ignored when `autoWidth`). Use it instead of hand-rolling an `input-like` label.
The Chat styling also applies to the shared Chat history surface (inPanel), so check both.
